subject: examples
narration: E0.3：为 Gauss（单位立方体）与 Stokes（水平单位正方形）补定向反例。Gauss 侧把六个面的法向逐面取反；Stokes 侧把参数化的两个切向量次序交换。
goal: ⊢ boxBoundaryFlux3Inward F a b = -boxBoundaryFlux3 F a b ∧ rectangleBoundaryIntegral (pullback₁ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquareRev) (pullback₂ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquareRev) 0 0 1 1 = -1
plan: Gauss：对和式用 ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib 后逐项 ring；Stokes：仿照文件内既有的 hP/hQ 计算拉回系数，再算矩形边界积分

  rw [boxBoundaryFlux3Inward, boxBoundaryFlux3, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring
...
  have hP : surfacePullbackCoeff₁ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquareRev = fun z ↦ z.2 := by
    funext z
    simp [surfacePullbackCoeff₁, xDyForm, horizontalUnitSquareRev, affinePlane, surfaceTangent₁_affinePlane]
  rw [hP, hQ, rectangleBoundaryIntegral]
  norm_num
